training-report v1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Generates professional training or workshop reports in .docx format, with a robust, step-by-step workflow.
- Triggers automatically for any request to document training, workshops, or onboarding events (in English or French).
- Guides user through structured interview batches to gather metadata, context, session walkthrough, participant feedback, recommendations, and annexes.
- Supports brand customization through Word template uploads or simple color branding.
- Checks for essential dependencies (docx skill) and recommends humanizer skill for polished final drafts.
- Produces a Markdown draft first, ensuring transparency and quality before .docx export.
